[SWS_CM_10285] Responsibility of proper string encoding
⌈
The application pro-
vides the string always in the UTF-8 encoding. The SOME/IP binding has to re-encode
the data to the on-the-wire encoding that is configured by ApSomeipTransforma-
tionProps.stringEncoding.

[SWS_CM_10285] Responsibility of proper string encoding
⌈
The application provides the string always in the UTF-8 encoding. The SOME/IP
binding has to re-encode the data to the on-the-wire encoding that is configured
by ApSomeipTransformationProps.stringEncoding. If ApSomeipTransfor-
mationProps.stringEncoding is not configured explicitly, the default value for
STRING_ENCODING defined in [PRS_SOMEIP_00372] shall be used.
